review.summary: Both round-1 findings are fixed by a documentation-only commit that changes ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/TESTING.md and the TASK-066A task file. The reworded tsconfig note is accurate for Prettier 3.9.9, and the ARCHITECTURE.md tech-stack line and the docs/TESTING.md tool list now name Prettier consistently with AGENTS.md, README.md and ADR-001. One frontend technology list in ARCHITECTURE.md still omits Prettier, so the task's new amendment, which says every tech-stack and tool list names Prettier, is not yet true. Lint, tests and build were not rerun by the reviewer because the commit changes documentation only; they passed on this head before the review.

findings.summary: The frontend technology list in the Frontend section of ARCHITECTURE.md still omits Prettier.
findings.rationale: The TASK-066A amendment extends the documentation update so every tech-stack and tool list names Prettier. This list includes ESLint, and the matching backend list includes Ruff, so ARCHITECTURE.md now describes the frontend tooling in two different ways.
findings.recommendation: Add Prettier after ESLint in the frontend technology list and mention that list in the task's Documentation bullet for ARCHITECTURE.md.

prior_finding_dispositions.rationale: The task note now says Prettier formats the tsconfig files with its json parser, which keeps comments and never adds trailing commas; Prettier 3.9.9 file-info and a scratch tsconfig with comments formatted under every trailingComma setting confirmed this.
The ARCHITECTURE.md tech-stack line and the docs/TESTING.md tool list now name Prettier, and the task's Documentation section and Source Plan amendment cover both files.
